title: Scaffolding Collisions from Direct Head-On Restitution to Successive Multi-Bounce Wall and Floor Trajectories
physical_system: Colliding smooth spherical masses m1 and m2 governed by linear momentum conservation and Newton's coefficient of restitution e

rungs.level_name: Direct 1D head-on elastic collision and velocity exchange
rungs.physical_delta: Two smooth particles collide elastically (e = 1) along a line without rotation, solving for post-collision speeds
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Linear system of equations combining momentum conservation and relative velocity separation condition v2 - v1 = u1 - u2
rungs.transfer_requirement: Recognizing complete velocity exchange when masses are identical (m1 = m2)

rungs.level_name: Inelastic head-on collision and kinetic energy dissipation
rungs.physical_delta: Head-on collision with coefficient of restitution 0 < e < 1, computing final velocities and fraction of mechanical energy dissipated as heat
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Algebraic calculation of kinetic energy loss Delta K = 1/2 * (m1 m2)/(m1 + m2) * (1 - e^2) * (u1 - u2)^2
rungs.transfer_requirement: Proving that maximum kinetic energy is dissipated in a perfectly inelastic collision (e = 0)

rungs.level_name: 2D oblique inelastic rebound off flat barrier
rungs.physical_delta: Particle strikes stationary smooth flat floor at incidence angle alpha with restitution e, resolving normal and tangential components
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Invariance of tangential velocity component v_t = u_t coupled with normal restitution v_n = e u_n yielding rebound angle tan(beta) = (1/e) tan(alpha)
rungs.transfer_requirement: Understanding that zero tangential impulse at smooth interface preserves the parallel velocity component

rungs.level_name: Infinite geometric bouncing scaffolding and total cessation time
rungs.physical_delta: Particle repeatedly rebounds vertically from floor under gravity with coefficient of restitution e, evaluating infinite geometric progressions
rungs.mathematical_complexity: Summing infinite geometric series for rebound heights h_n = e^(2n) h_0 and flight times t_n = 2 e^n sqrt(2h_0/g) to find total time T_tot = sqrt(2h_0/g) * (1+e)/(1-e) and total distance S_tot = h_0 * (1+e^2)/(1-e^2)
rungs.transfer_requirement: Synthesizing impulse, restitution decay, and infinite series convergence in classical mechanics

pedagogical_objective: Systematically scaffold collision physics from one-dimensional elastic velocity exchange to inelastic energy dissipation, 2D oblique normal/tangential resolution, and cumulative geometric rebound damping.
